Install the policy block into agent instruction files

Usage: kprun agents install [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --path <PATH>      Target directory for repo-level install (default: current directory)
  -g, --global           Write the global instruction files of installed agents instead of repo files
      --target <TARGET>  Comma-separated tools to install for, skipping auto-detection (requires -g) [possible values: claude, codex, opencode, windsurf, copilot, cursor]
  -h, --help             Print help
